levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
أحمد بن محمد بن أبي نصر البزنطي

notes: «قلت لأبي عبدالله» : the Imam named only in the words after the chain is the last link

داود's first-person narrative continues «ثم أتيت أبا الحسن موسى» with no new isnad: a first-person narrative with implicit transmission, so the Imam Musa is not written as a link and a ruling is needed
